nodes.title: Production and inventory planning
nodes.summary: Plan production, inventory, replenishment, setup, and backlog decisions over time.

nodes.title: Combinatorial scheduling
nodes.summary: Schedule jobs, machines, shifts, and other scarce resources with precedence and non-overlap rules.

nodes.title: Service vehicle routing
nodes.summary: Construct vehicle routes to serve customers or passengers from one or more depots.

nodes.title: Transport and network design
nodes.summary: Route flow through transportation or activated network arcs under balance and capacity rules.

nodes.title: Dial-a-Ride and passenger routing
nodes.summary: Paired passenger pickup and delivery with vehicle continuity, capacity, time windows, and ride-time limits.

nodes.title: DARP with time windows and maximum ride time
nodes.summary: A composite routing formulation for paired pickup and delivery requests with same-vehicle, precedence, passenger-load, time-window, and maximum-ride-time constraints.

variables: x[v,i,j] binary: vehicle v traverses arc i->j
y[r,v] binary: request r uses vehicle v
blueprint.instantiation_rule: Bind request pickup/dropoff pairs and vehicle/node data before expanding indexed constraints.

validation_checks: every request has exactly one pickup and delivery
pickup and delivery use the same vehicle
pickup precedes delivery
route load never exceeds capacity
all service starts satisfy time windows
ride time limits hold
routes start and end at a depot
payload.use: Composite retrieval profile; instantiate equations only after checking the supplied request, vehicle, node, and travel-time data.

nodes.title: Dial-a-Ride (DARP): pickup-delivery, time windows, capacity, and ride time
nodes.summary: Route paired passenger requests while preserving same-vehicle service, pickup-before-delivery order, capacity, time windows, and a maximum ride duration.

nodes.title: Integrated facility location and routing
nodes.summary: Jointly choose facilities and construct customer routes under assignment, capacity, and service constraints.

nodes.title: Capacitated facility-location routing with time windows
nodes.summary: A composite model linking facility opening, customer assignment, vehicle routes, capacity, and route time windows.

blueprint.objective: minimize facility opening cost plus assignment and route travel cost
blueprint.instantiation_rule: Choose a joint route formulation only when facility and route decisions are simultaneous; otherwise preserve the stated two-stage semantics.

validation_checks: every customer is assigned once
no assignment uses a closed facility
route capacity and time windows hold
all selected routes connect to an opened facility
payload.use: Composite retrieval profile; confirm whether facilities and routes are jointly or sequentially decided.

nodes.title: Integrated capacitated facility location and routing with time windows
nodes.summary: Open facilities, assign customers, and route vehicles from selected facilities while enforcing capacity and time windows.

nodes.title: Stochastic and robust planning
nodes.summary: Plan under uncertain demand or parameters using scenarios, recourse, robust protection, or chance constraints.

nodes.title: Scenario-based production scheduling with robust or chance constraints
nodes.summary: A composite planning formulation with first-stage decisions, scenario recourse, uncertainty protection, and optional service probability constraints.

variables: x first-stage production or capacity decisions
u[s] violation or shortage variables when permitted
blueprint.objective: minimize first-stage cost plus expected or worst-case recourse cost
blueprint.instantiation_rule: Choose expected-value, worst-case, or chance-constrained semantics from the statement; do not silently replace one with another.

validation_checks: scenario data and probabilities sum correctly
first-stage decisions are scenario-independent
each scenario satisfies capacity and demand rules
chance or robust guarantees are recomputed from the reported solution

nodes.title: Stochastic or robust production scheduling with recourse
nodes.summary: Schedule production under uncertain demand using scenarios, recourse, robust protection, or chance constraints.

nodes.title: Grid labeling with line-count objective
nodes.summary: Assign discrete symbols to a fixed grid and count complete or monochromatic lines induced by the assignment.

nodes.title: Binary grid labeling with complete-line minimization
nodes.summary: Use binary cell-label variables and line indicator variables to minimize the number of complete lines while filling every cell.

source_basis: internal pattern extracted from the 4x4x4 cooperative tic-tac-toe formulation case

variables: h[line,symbol] binary: line is complete in symbol
constraint_templates: h[line,symbol] <= z[cell,symbol] for every cell on line
blueprint.instantiation_rule: Generate the candidate line list from the board geometry; do not assume only axis-aligned lines.

validation_checks: every cell receives exactly one symbol
each line indicator matches all cells on that line
the objective recounts all complete lines
turn or symbol-count rules are respected
payload.use: Retrieval profile for grid-labeling problems; line definitions and symmetry choices remain instance-specific.

nodes.title: 3D grid symbol assignment minimizing complete lines
nodes.summary: Fill a three-dimensional board with symbols and minimize complete same-symbol rows, columns, layers, or diagonals.

nodes.title: Same-vehicle pickup-delivery pairing
nodes.summary: Link the pickup and delivery decisions for one request to the same vehicle and require both stops when the request is served.

nodes.title: Maximum passenger ride-time constraint
nodes.summary: Bound delivery time minus pickup time, including service-time conventions, for every served passenger request.

nodes.title: Capacitated vehicle routing with time windows
nodes.summary: A routing formulation with vehicle capacity, customer time-window propagation, depot continuity, and subtour control.

blueprint.objective: minimize total route distance or travel time
blueprint.instantiation_rule: Use the supplied matrix units and time-window horizon to derive valid propagation bounds.

validation_checks: each customer is visited once
capacity never exceeds vehicle limit
arrival times lie in windows
each route starts and ends at its depot

nodes.title: Capacitated VRP with time windows (CVRPTW)
nodes.summary: Visit each customer once with capacity-limited vehicles while respecting customer time windows and depot route continuity.

aliases: capacitated vehicle routing with time windows
带时间窗的容量车辆路径

nodes.title: Complete-line indicator
nodes.summary: Introduce an indicator for each candidate line and activate it only when every cell on that line carries the same symbol.
